entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Sadness, misery, grief, despair, loneliness, regret; Heart, throat, lump, sobs
entries.zh: 悲伤、痛苦、哀恸、绝望、孤独、悔恨；心、喉咙、硬结、抽泣。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Cold, hollow; Painful, horrible
entries.zh: 冰冷、空洞；痛苦、可怕。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Filled, welled, choked, broke
entries.zh: 充满、涌起、哽住、崩溃爆发。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Silent, shuddering sobs
entries.zh: 无声而颤抖的抽泣

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Heart was swollen and bruised
entries.zh: 心仿佛肿痛、伤痕累累

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Felt hollow and cold
entries.zh: 感到空洞而冰冷

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Huge lump in the back of his throat
entries.zh: 喉咙深处堵着一大块硬结

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Horrible sense of loneliness like a dark fog
entries.zh: 可怕的孤独感像浓黑的雾

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sadness erupted inside him
entries.zh: 悲伤在体内爆发

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Enveloped her like a dark cloud
entries.zh: 像乌云一样笼罩她

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Spread through his chest like a dull ache
entries.zh: 像隐痛一样在胸中蔓延

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Wild grief was building inside her
entries.zh: 强烈的悲痛在她体内不断积聚

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Despair washed over him
entries.zh: 绝望席卷而来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Insides curled up and shrivelled
entries.zh: 五脏六腑仿佛蜷缩干瘪

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Hopelessness washed over him
entries.zh: 无望感淹没了他

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Coldness settled inside him
entries.zh: 寒意在体内沉淀下来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Gripping pain in his heart
entries.zh: 揪心的疼痛

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sob welled up in her throat
entries.zh: 抽泣涌到喉咙口

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Weight of his grief was crushing his windpipe
entries.zh: 悲痛的重量压住了气管

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: His despair tightened around his chest in a vice-like grip
entries.zh: 绝望像虎钳般夹紧胸口

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: All thought and reason had shut down
entries.zh: 思考与理智全部停止运转

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The pain of his loss spread through his chest like a dull ache.
entries.zh: 失去所爱的痛苦像隐痛般在他胸中蔓延。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A horrible sense of loneliness bled through her.
entries.zh: 一种可怕的孤独感渗遍她全身。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The gripping pain in her heart was reflected in her haunted expression.
entries.zh: 她备受折磨的神情映出心里揪紧的疼痛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Sadness filled his chest and erupted in a wail of misery.
entries.zh: 悲伤充满他的胸口，化作痛苦的哀号爆发出来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He buried his head in his hands and tried to block out the sadness erupting inside him.
entries.zh: 他把头埋在双手里，想挡住体内爆发的悲伤。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She felt a rush of anguish surge into her chest and throat, and flood her eyes with tears.
entries.zh: 她感到一阵悲痛涌入胸口与喉咙，泪水充满双眼。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She felt a wild grief building inside her – taking her over – until she could only break down in an agony of weeping.
entries.zh: 强烈的悲痛在她体内积聚、占据她，直到她只能崩溃痛哭。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Sadness, misery, grief, pain, despair; Face, mouth, jaw, chin, lips, teeth; Tears, sobs
entries.zh: 悲伤、痛苦、哀恸、疼痛、绝望；脸、嘴、下颌、下巴、嘴唇、牙齿；泪水、抽泣。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Sad, unhappy, haunted; Wet, red, swollen, blotchy
entries.zh: 伤心、不快乐、饱受折磨；湿、红、肿、斑驳。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Trembled, wobbled; Twisted, tightened, faltered, crumpled; Bit, pressed, jammed; Welled, poured, spilled
entries.zh: 颤抖、晃动；扭曲、绷紧、动摇、皱缩；咬、抿、抵紧；涌起、流下、溢出。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Wet and red from weeping
entries.zh: 哭得又湿又红

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Swollen and blotchy
entries.zh: 肿胀且一块块泛红

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Quivering lips
entries.zh: 颤抖的嘴唇

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Haunted expression
entries.zh: 备受折磨的神情

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Lips trembled
entries.zh: 双唇发颤

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Jaw wobbled
entries.zh: 下颌颤动

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Jaw trembled as she spoke
entries.zh: 说话时下巴发抖

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Twisted in an unhappy smile
entries.zh: 扭出一个不快乐的笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Pressed lips together
entries.zh: 紧抿双唇

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Bit her lip until she drew blood
entries.zh: 咬唇咬出了血

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Jammed her knuckles against her teeth
entries.zh: 把指关节死死抵在牙齿上

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Expression faltered as her chin started to tremble
entries.zh: 下巴开始发抖，强撑的表情也维持不住

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Contorted with pain and misery
entries.zh: 因疼痛与悲伤而扭曲

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She jammed her knuckles against her teeth.
entries.zh: 她把指关节死死抵住牙齿。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She pressed her quivering lips together to smother the sob that welled in her throat.
entries.zh: 她抿紧发颤的双唇，压住喉咙里涌起的抽泣。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His jaw tightened and his mouth twisted in an unhappy smile.
entries.zh: 他下颌绷紧，嘴扭出一个苦笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She tried to hold the smile, but her expression faltered as her chin started to tremble.
entries.zh: 她想保持微笑，但下巴一颤，表情就撑不住了。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She bit her lip to stem the tears that welled up in her eyes and threatened to spill onto her face.
entries.zh: 她咬住嘴唇，试图止住眼里即将溢出的泪水。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her face became shadowed with grief and misery as she remembered the last time they had met.
entries.zh: 想起他们上一次见面，她脸上蒙上了悲痛的阴影。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Grief, tears
entries.zh: 悲痛、泪水。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Wet, teary, watery, cloudy, glassy, bloodshot, swollen; Dull, gloomy, blank, vacant, shadowed, downcast, forlorn
entries.zh: 湿润、含泪、水汪汪、朦胧、呆滞发亮、布满血丝、肿胀；暗淡、忧郁、茫然、空洞、阴郁、低垂、凄凉。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Wept, poured, streamed, spilled; Filled, blurred
entries.zh: 哭、倾泻、流淌、溢出；充满、模糊。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Cloudy and sad
entries.zh: 朦胧而悲伤

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Glassy eyes
entries.zh: 呆滞无神的眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Gloomy and downcast
entries.zh: 忧郁而低垂

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Vacant expression
entries.zh: 空洞的表情

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: As if in a trance
entries.zh: 仿佛恍惚失神

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Shiny slug trails down her face
entries.zh: 脸上的泪痕像蛞蝓留下的亮痕

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Wet and bloodshot from weeping
entries.zh: 哭得湿润且布满血丝

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Tears streamed from her eyes
entries.zh: 眼泪不断流下

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Spilled out of her eyes
entries.zh: 从眼中溢出

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Blurred his vision
entries.zh: 模糊他的视线

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Scalded her cheeks as they flowed
entries.zh: 泪流过时灼痛脸颊

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Filled with grief
entries.zh: 充满悲痛

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Stared with glassy eyes
entries.zh: 用呆滞的眼睛盯着

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Screwed eyes shut to hold back the tears
entries.zh: 紧闭双眼强忍泪水

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Stared as if in a trance
entries.zh: 失神般凝视

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Stared unblinking at the ground in front of him
entries.zh: 一眨不眨地盯着面前的地面

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her dark brown eyes filled with grief.
entries.zh: 她深棕色的眼睛充满悲伤。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her lips started to tremble and her eyes filled with tears.
entries.zh: 她的嘴唇开始发颤，泪水充盈双眼。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Robert stared at her with glassy eyes and then screwed them shut to hold back the flood of tears.
entries.zh: 罗伯特目光呆滞地看着她，然后紧闭双眼，强忍奔涌的泪水。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The pain of her loss filled her chest like a dull ache and her eyes grew clouded and sad.
entries.zh: 失去所爱的痛苦像钝痛般填满她的胸口，她的双眼变得朦胧悲伤。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was crying again, the tears spilling out of her eyes and leaving shiny slug trails down her face.
entries.zh: 她又哭了，眼泪不断溢出，在脸上留下像蛞蝓爬过般闪亮的痕迹。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face was shadowed with grief and misery, as he stared unblinking at the ground in front of him.
entries.zh: 他一眨不眨地盯着面前的地面，脸上笼罩着悲痛的阴影。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Without any warning, tears welled up in her eyes and poured down her face, scalding her cheeks as they flowed.
entries.zh: 毫无预兆，泪水涌满她的眼睛，沿脸流下，灼痛了双颊。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Emotion, tone; Sadness, misery, grief, despair, anguish; Sob, sigh, whisper, murmur, moan, groan, wail, howl
entries.zh: 情绪、语气；悲伤、痛苦、哀恸、绝望、悲痛；抽泣、叹息、耳语、低语、呻吟、低哼、哀号、嚎哭。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Quiet, low, grave, solemn, husky, gruff, hoarse; Shaky, choking, quivering, gurgling, shuddering; Heartfelt, forlorn
entries.zh: 安静、低沉、沉重、肃穆、沙哑、粗哑、嘶哑；颤抖、哽咽、发颤、咯咯、战栗；发自内心、凄凉。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Cried, wept, sobbed; Shook, trembled; Cracked, crumpled, swallowed, stifled, strangled
entries.zh: 哭、流泪、抽泣；抖动、颤抖；破音、变得破碎、吞咽、强忍、哽住。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Wild, ragged wail
entries.zh: 狂乱破碎的哀号

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Quiet groan
entries.zh: 低低的呻吟

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Low, gurgling moan
entries.zh: 低沉、咯咯的呻吟

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Moan of despair
entries.zh: 绝望的呻吟

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Stifled sob
entries.zh: 强忍的抽泣

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Shuddering sobs
entries.zh: 颤抖的抽泣

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Quivering whisper
entries.zh: 发颤的低语

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Husky with emotion
entries.zh: 因情绪激动而沙哑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Full of sadness
entries.zh: 充满悲伤

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Heartfelt sigh
entries.zh: 发自内心的叹息

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Unshed tears in her voice
entries.zh: 嗓音里含着没流出的泪

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Tone was forlorn
entries.zh: 语气凄凉

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Let out a quiet groan
entries.zh: 低低地呻吟一声

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sobbed softly
entries.zh: 轻轻抽泣

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Choked with misery
entries.zh: 悲伤得哽咽

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Shook and cracked with grief
entries.zh: 因悲痛而发抖、破音

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Swallowed hard before speaking
entries.zh: 说话前用力咽了一下

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Howled like a wounded dog
entries.zh: 像受伤的狗一样嚎哭

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sob welled up in her throat
entries.zh: 哭声涌到喉咙口

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Broke out as a strangled moan
entries.zh: 迸出哽塞的呻吟

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Uncontrollable sobbing racked her body
entries.zh: 无法控制的抽泣使全身震颤

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His voice trailed off into a heartfelt sigh.
entries.zh: 他的声音慢慢弱下去，化作一声由衷的叹息。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She broke into a sudden and uncontrollable sobbing.
entries.zh: 她突然无法控制地抽泣起来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her words came in gasps and tears poured down her cheeks.
entries.zh: 她边喘边说，泪水不断流过脸颊。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She rose shakily to her feet and her voice trembled as she greeted him.
entries.zh: 她颤巍巍地站起来，向他打招呼时声音发抖。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: When he spoke, his voice was a gruff whisper.
entries.zh: 他开口时，声音是粗哑的低语。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Shaking her head, she slumped to the ground and wept.
entries.zh: 她摇着头瘫坐在地，哭了起来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: With a moan of despair, he buried his head in his hands.
entries.zh: 他绝望地呻吟一声，把头埋进双手。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Kitty’s voice sank to a murmur, as a single tear trickled down her cheek.
entries.zh: 一滴泪沿基蒂的脸颊滚落，她的声音也低成了呢喃。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her eyes were filled with grief and, as she spoke, her voice crumpled with misery.
entries.zh: 她眼里满是悲痛，开口时声音因伤心而破碎。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She swallowed hard before speaking – trying to dislodge the hard lump stuck in her throat.
entries.zh: 她开口前用力咽了一下，想咽下堵在喉咙里的硬结。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Despite his efforts to conceal his disappointment, Robert’s voice was strained and husky with emotion.
entries.zh: 罗伯特努力掩饰失望，但声音仍因情绪激动而绷紧沙哑。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Body, head, eyes, lips, teeth; Arms, shoulders, elbows, hand, fist, palms, knuckles, fingernails; Legs, knees, feet
entries.zh: 身体、头、眼、唇、牙；手臂、肩、肘、手、拳、手掌、指关节、指甲；腿、膝、脚。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Bit, chewed, rubbed, pressed; Sniffed, wiped, brushed; Bent, stooped, hunched, slumped, slouched; Rocked, swayed
entries.zh: 咬、啃、揉、按；抽鼻子、擦、拂；弯、躬、弓背、瘫倒、无精打采地站；摇、晃。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Quietly, slowly, clumsily, unhappily, frantically
entries.zh: 安静地、缓慢地、笨拙地、难过地、疯狂地。

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Pressed palms into his eyes
entries.zh: 用手掌紧压眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Bit lip unhappily
entries.zh: 难过地咬嘴唇

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Chewed fingernails
entries.zh: 啃指甲

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Bit her knuckles
entries.zh: 咬自己的指关节

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Jammed her knuckles against her teeth
entries.zh: 把指关节死死抵住牙齿

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Brushed tears away with a clumsy fist
entries.zh: 用笨拙的拳头擦去泪水

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Wiped his eyes with the back of his hand
entries.zh: 用手背擦眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Shook his head frantically
entries.zh: 拼命摇头

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Head dropped onto his chest
entries.zh: 头垂到胸前

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Bent over with elbows on her knees
entries.zh: 弯着腰，把肘撑在膝上

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Hugged her body in both arms
entries.zh: 双臂抱住自己的身体

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Entire body was hunched over
entries.zh: 整个身体弓了起来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Slouched with hands in pockets
entries.zh: 双手插袋，垂头塌肩

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Slumped like a puppet with its strings cut
entries.zh: 像断线木偶般瘫倒

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Rocked back and forth quietly
entries.zh: 安静地前后摇晃

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Swayed on his feet
entries.zh: 站着摇摇欲坠

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Whole body was racked with sobs
entries.zh: 全身因抽泣而剧烈颤动

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Moved with agonizing slowness
entries.zh: 动作慢得令人难受

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Moved as if her legs were blocks of wood
entries.zh: 两腿仿佛是木块，僵硬地移动

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He sank down on the chair and hung his head in despair.
entries.zh: 他沉沉坐进椅子，绝望地低着头。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She rocked back and forth, with tears streaming quietly down her cheeks.
entries.zh: 她前后摇晃，泪水无声地沿双颊流下。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He crouched in the corner, tears spilling out of his eyes and snot bubbling in one nostril.
entries.zh: 他蹲在角落，眼泪不断溢出，一侧鼻孔冒着鼻涕泡。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He held his body rigid – jaws tight, back hunched – elbows pressed into his knees.
entries.zh: 他身体僵直，牙关紧咬、背弓着，双肘压在膝上。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He sniffed, wiped his eyes with the back of his hand and rose shakily to his feet.
entries.zh: 他抽抽鼻子，用手背擦眼睛，颤巍巍站起来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Hugging his body in both arms, he swayed backwards and forwards.
entries.zh: 他双臂紧抱身体，前后晃动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Rubbing her eyes, she brushed away the tears that blurred her vision.
entries.zh: 她揉着眼睛，拭去模糊视线的泪水。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: With a moan of despair, she slumped on the floor like a puppet with its strings cut.
entries.zh: 她绝望地呻吟一声，像断线木偶一样瘫倒在地。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was a picture of despair with his bowed head and stooped shoulders.
entries.zh: 他低着头、耷拉着肩，整个人就是绝望的写照。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Shuffling along, he moved slowly, awkwardly, as if his legs were blocks of wood and every movement was an effort.
entries.zh: 他拖着脚，缓慢笨拙地走，两腿仿佛是木块，每动一下都很费力。
